runs.rule: Track the performer as the longest overlap-linked chain of boxes, after 9 clips failed on the crossfade ghost.
Lost-leg detection by an impossible one-frame jump, and arc bridging about the hip (user: Pop 360 high kick missing).
Limbs turn with their parent through spins; a bridged leg stays in front of the trunk (user: lower body not turning, leg through the back).
Leg identity judged only between adjacent clear frames (user: J-step swing leg swapped). A first version, comparing across overlapped gaps, added false swaps and was overwritten.
Swing reversal counts as lost, lost while overlapped or a stub, straight-line bridge for foreshortened legs (user: J-step dip).
In an overlapped stretch the lost leg is the one that reappears far away; straight-line test by image leg length.
Limb roll carried frame to frame (user: Cheat 720 legs appear to swap at 0.82 s).
Knees bend forward only; each leg stays on its own side of the body (user screenshots of Cheat 720).
Turn continuity for shoulders and hips; relabel legs before an overlapped stretch when the reappearing leg was the other one (user screenshots of Backside 900).
Vision decisions on; agreeing answers veto swap repairs within three frames. Regressed Pop 360 (crescent).
Vision veto narrowed to confident detections and adjacent frames.

R22: when vision answers pin the labels before an overlapped stretch, relabel the frames after it instead of before. R23: a bridged swing continues the way the leg was rotating going into the gap. Prompted by Cheat 360 crescent's high kick (0.62-0.66 s).

R24: a bridged leg keeps its shape (thigh turn, knee bend and lengths ease from entry to exit). R25: a short clear run after an overlap whose labels are the exchange of the next frame is relabelled. Prompted by user review of Cheat 360 crescent at 0.72-0.97 s: legs keep their shape while the body rotates.
R25 corrected: the island relabel runs once, after the other label rules; the in-loop version (run 14) cascaded swaps through the 540 kick landing.
R26: unseen leg re-observed on turned frames sets how far round the bridge is; front-of-trunk rule off on re-observed frames
R27: knee is a hinge (shin swings from the thigh, thigh rolled so the bend is pure); knees and elbows fold at most 150 degrees; joint-range report
R28: leg stays 0.7 hip widths from the pelvis-neck line (depth only); front-of-trunk rule acts in depth only, on every bridged frame
R28 narrowed: trunk clearance only for bridged legs inside their bridge; front-of-trunk rule depth only
Rollback to R27 (commit adfe5f9) after rejected trunk-clearance and depth-only front experiments
R28: vision model asked for chest and face separately; low-confidence chest answer counts when the face agrees; opposite neighbouring answers dropped; hip turn kept near its previous value
R29: limb depth mirrored where the turn rule flips the body against the lift
R30: body parts are solid (limbs clear of trunk, head, other limbs; moved apart in depth only)
R30: body parts are solid, tested at the character's own proportions; moved apart in depth only
R31: no unnecessary depth movement (a-b-c); R30 revised: only limb joints move, knee not tested against trunk; thigh and shin keep proportion
R30 revised again: knee tested against a slimmer trunk; inside measured as a depth shortfall with a definite side
Baseline for R32: run 26 fit, crossings now counted on the rig
R32: nothing passes through anything across time (one side per stretch of overlap; same side in and out, else chest side, else least movement)
R33: a widely swung bridged leg takes its straighter shape through the middle of the gap
R34: against the trunk or head a limb takes the side its own shoulder or hip is on, leaning to the chest
R35: the fit keeps 3 cm more room than the rig measure asks, to cover the difference between its model of the character and the rig
R36: room is made early and given back late around an overlap (need tapered over six frames each side; R31 allows it)
R36 narrowed: early room only around overlaps of up to three frames
Back to R35 (commit aa2b1a4) after rejected early-room experiments
